coding\"}]},{\"_key\":\"fd11dd86eb0a\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"4471007234a8\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Fable 5.1 avoids shortcuts that result in poorer-quality work, and it’s smart enough to fix the root causes of software issues. For example, in testing by the investment firm Millennium, Fable 5.1 found the cause of a rare crash in its internal systems that none of its engineers (or any other model) had been able to explain after several years of trying.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"b8a88e4c8e64\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"5e5d82f2caa7\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Here, you can see how Fable 5.1 compares across various benchmarks:\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"1ff33c052127\",\"_type\":\"benchmarkGrid\",\"caption\":\"Fable 5.1 was evaluated with its production safeguards enabled. On tasks where these safeguards intervened, Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 scored a zero on OSWorld 2.0, and Fable 5 scored a zero on AutomationBench. In all other interventions from our safeguards, cybersecurity tasks were completed by Claude Opus 4.8, and biology tasks were completed by Claude Opus 5. This likely reduces the performance of Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 on these benchmarks.\",\"competitorModels\":\"GPT-5.6 Sol\",\"data\":\"category,benchmark,qualifier,Fable 5.1,Fable 5,Opus 5,GPT-5.6 Sol\\nAgentic scientific research,Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 [1],,52.6%,24.7%,29.0%,22.4%\\nAgentic coding,Terminal-Bench 4.0,,55.8% | 60.9% (Mythos 5.1),42.0%,52.3%,37.3%\\nKnowledge work,GDPval-AA v2,,1853,1723,1824,1711\\nComputer use,OSWorld 2.0 [2],partial,77.9%,72.9%,75.4%,—\\nComputer use,OSWorld 2.0,strict,41.7%,36.1%,39.6%,—\\nMultidisciplinary reasoning,Humanity's Last Exam,no tools,60.9%,57.8%,56.6%,—\\nMultidisciplinary reasoning,Humanity's Last Exam,with tools,65.0%,63.8%,63.6%,—\\nBusiness workflows,AutomationBench,,31.4%,17.1%,26.9%,19.6%\\nAgentic coding,CursorBench 3.2.0,,73.4%,70.5%,70.0%,67.2%\",\"highlightModel\":\"Fable 5.1\",\"markDefs\":null},{\"_key\":\"fb1e223f573c\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"d53209ed7c6a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Our early-access partners noticed these performance upgrades, and also picked up on more qualitative improvements in the model’s outputs. Here’s what they told us:\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"79ccb1bed281\",\"_type\":\"testimonialCarousel\",\"authorLabel\":\"Author\",\"companyLabel\":\"Company\",\"markDefs\":null,\"quotes\":[{\"_key\":\"8888beaa8eca\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Craig Falls\",\"authorRole\":\"Head of Quantitative Research\",\"company\":\"Jane Street Capital\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"c978df98e324\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"94ea31fba0f0\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“In internal benchmarks, Claude Fable 5.1 solves more of our coding problems than Fable 5 or Opus 5, and achieves state of the art on trading intuition. While prior models became hard to follow the longer they worked, Fable 5.1 remains readable over long, multi-step tasks.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"8ffce0f3456c\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Walden Yan\",\"authorRole\":\"Co-founder and CPO\",\"company\":\"Cognition\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"0f5b7676d2ea\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"ed918001cf64\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“We’re moving our Opus 5 traffic in Devin to Claude Fable 5.1 on launch day. It matched or edged out Fable 5 in our testing at a lower cost per task, and with the new cache read pricing a Fable-class model is finally economical for the workloads we’d kept on Opus, starting with code review.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"87be5743c44b\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Damien\",\"authorRole\":\"Senior Portfolio Manager\",\"company\":\"Millennium\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"e6071d0f3592\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"9e36c0174d37\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“A particular piece of code had an extremely rare crash, about one in a million runs, that nobody on our team had explained in four to five years. Every model I tried, including Fable 5, missed it. Claude Fable 5.1 was the first to find it. It disassembled an external vendor library, matched it against the core dump, and traced the crash to a bug in that library. The time it would have taken to conduct that analysis is hard to justify.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"12bec4524ca4\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Ron Sanzone\",\"authorRole\":\"Staff Software Engineer\",\"company\":\"MongoDB\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"6ac45699e140\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"6355271826ed\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“Claude Fable 5.1 built a complex prototype in about three days. It did initial research across all of our services code and documentation to produce a novel and extensible design. It then ran for hours unattended, with strong verification loops, to implement the entire prototype. I would wake up in the morning to the next phase finished, with a full visual walkthrough of what it built and clear evidence of its success.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"0b7b347c1f8a\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Dan Shipper\",\"authorRole\":\"CEO\",\"company\":\"Every\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"937cb0080369\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"8e906320b207\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“It’s friendly Fable. Fable-level intelligence, Opus-level price, Sonnet-speed. In our tests it was about twice as fast as Opus 5 and used half as many tokens, so for anyone used to using Opus as their daily driver it’s an obvious upgrade.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"ffe33246fdb8\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Marquis Wong\",\"authorRole\":\"Principal AI Engineer\",\"company\":\"IMC\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"7f6c4253c88c\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"0fc0dafe8561\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“On our research suite, Claude Fable 5.1 set new best scores. On one task it came up with a novel solution along a completely different axis than we’d seen from other models or from human researchers in the past, which took its results well above the previous plateau. It's better at creative problem solving and getting that flash of insight you need to solve a difficult problem.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"c4e64bbcd354\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Josh Boyer\",\"authorRole\":\"Distinguished Engineer\",\"company\":\"Red Hat\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"6b35fe4a146b\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"c115ef70de06\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“As part of our ongoing evaluation of AI models, Claude Fable 5.1 delivered impressive results in our tests. Using Claude Code, it correctly identified the root cause of every broken build we tested, across all the effort levels. It also communicates more effectively than earlier Anthropic models, with updates that are more concise and easier to follow.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"4009dc6c8a4d\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Felix Giovanni Virgo\",\"authorRole\":\"Principal AI Engineer\",\"company\":\"Rakuten\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"47cb6cfb8de5\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"f3b4e6223454\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“We asked Claude Fable 5.1 to review a clinical research project for Rakuten Medical that three other frontier models had signed off on. It found a gap none of them had seen and insisted on testing it further. It then proposed a completely new hypothesis, turning a dataset we had written off into a new research direction in one afternoon. It’s the first time a frontier model like Claude has empowered us to explore new research in this way.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"7e8936b2cb26\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Willem Avé\",\"authorRole\":\"Global Head of Product\",\"company\":\"Block\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"685b3adbd015\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"90da1b1479df\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“Claude Fable 5.1 is very smart. On our 30-day simulated run-a-business eval, where the model gets full access to simulated Square tools, customers, employees, and vendors, it was far more efficient per token than Opus 5. We plan to use it to work through our most complex scenarios, the kind that used to take days of whiteboarding, so our engineering teams can keep moving fast.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"a23a3f974a50\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Dwight Temple\",\"authorRole\":\"Sr. Machine Learning Engineer\",\"company\":\"Ramp\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"c8bf207a1cbc\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"0f64f47bc866\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“For anything research, greenfield or long-horizon, I would absolutely use Claude Fable 5.1 as the orchestrator. One unattended 38-hour run on a machine learning problem diagnosed a prior result as a label artifact, made the correction, kicked off six parallel experiments that ran overnight, and returned with a result and next steps. Given an open-ended prompt to find the highest-leverage problem nobody owned, it surfaced an unowned alert tied to a production outage, pulled the logs and prescribed the fix.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"b523c4737bfe\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Danny Wu\",\"authorRole\":\"Head of AI\",\"company\":\"Canva\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"cd18eec416d8\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"d24e36c585f8\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“The standout in Claude Fable 5.1 is the writing: more understandable, more meaningful, and it follows our writing guidance better. In blind tests against Fable 5, I preferred its writing and output. And in Canva Code it built a rhythm game with real music and on-beat gameplay matched to the level it generated, something no other model we tested delivered.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"172cf95cc825\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Aabhas Sharma\",\"authorRole\":\"CTO\",\"company\":\"Hebbia\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"62465b43a999\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"cd06af6a1036\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“On our PowerPoint eval, Claude Fable 5.1 produced the best decks of any model we’ve tested, both in slide craft and in fully answering our research topic. That same completeness showed up in our Citations eval, where it had the best fact recall over financial documents. And on complex, multi-part questions, it’s the first model we’ve seen answer every part.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"ef2ef0cca578\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Aditya Gupta\",\"authorRole\":\"Staff Software Engineer\",\"company\":\"Plaid\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"11b5b6d9853b\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"2580d8eb50e4\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“We had a change that touched more than eight services across three codebases. Claude Fable 5.1 mapped the whole workflow end to end, in extremely fine detail, from the incoming service call down to the individual function and the database tables and rows, and it was accurate all the way down. We appreciated the opportunity to test the model and provide feedback, helping us prepare for a new frontier where we can increasingly rely on these tools to take on bolder initiatives.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"cccc0d4f0313\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Nilesh Dalvi\",\"authorRole\":\"Engineering Lead\",\"company\":\"Glean\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"0a3d11bec785\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"a14e776e43b2\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“Across our evaluation sets, our judges preferred Claude Fable 5.1’s answers roughly 2-to-1 over Fable 5 on everyday knowledge questions, high-intent research, and drafting and artifact work, all with improved response grounding over Fable. These results have made Fable 5.1 our go-to recommendation wherever Fable 5 was previously the choice.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"bcb41d0bcb46\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Sean Ward\",\"authorRole\":\"Co-founder and CEO\",\"company\":\"iGent\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"aac21b8d8aaa\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"d22d6f8040d0\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“On the hardest problems we work on, Claude Fable 5.1 separates strongly from any other model we’ve tried. On a grand challenge-tier problem we‘ve used as a testbed for 18 months, it actually produced material progress. Rather than being trapped in stamp collecting, it made clear white-space connections I have yet to see elsewhere. It also optimized a compute kernel that Fable 5 had tapped out on by about 35%.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"544346116c35\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Miguel Gonzalez\",\"authorRole\":\"Technical Lead\",\"company\":\"Browserbase\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"4139efba51b2\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"913ae08a17e2\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“On our hardest browser-agent benchmark, Claude Fable 5.1 completed 82% of tasks in about 10 minutes each, against 74% for Opus 5 and 57% for Fable 5, while using fewer tokens than either. It feels stronger than Fable 5 in every dimension we test. It also did exactly the right amount of work: never crossed a critical stop point across hundreds of measured tasks.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"8a4f40bcf994\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Alex Wang\",\"authorRole\":\"Applied AI\",\"company\":\"Rogo\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"3ed945b3a717\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"6dbb0fcb8a46\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“On our internal Finance benchmark, Claude Fable 5.1 matches Fable 5 on accuracy while using 20% fewer tokens. We also saw big gains in slide generation, with Fable 5.1 showing improvements in explaining complex data in simpler English and translating it into more banker-grade visuals.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"a756ef1e905a\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Ben Lafferty\",\"authorRole\":\"Senior Staff Engineer\",\"company\":\"Shopify\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"03f88ca3838c\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"b76c14370a4f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“Claude Fable 5.1 is more comfortable with long, unattended work than Fable 5. I’ve had workflows run for a long stretch without losing the plot: it keeps its own records, reprioritizes as things change, and picks up where it left off.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"bd3b561c50f4\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Raymond Lin\",\"authorRole\":\"Member of Technical Staff\",\"company\":\"Crosby\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"32cba3336ba3\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"31b0d5ac5760\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“Compared to Fable 5, Claude Fable 5.1 was a massive improvement on RedlineBench, our contract redlining benchmark, improving from 47.9 to 57.0. Most of the gain came on first-turn quality, where it doubled the previous score, with substantial gains on counterparty acceptance as well. Its edits were also more concise, with smaller changes on average to the documents.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"63837a9e6f29\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Daniel Shan\",\"authorRole\":\"Staff Engineer\",\"company\":\"Datadog\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"df94f96fcd89\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"4b085fe3da7c\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“Claude Fable 5.1 is a leading model for our incident investigation evals, which use real production incidents to assess how effectively our agent, Bits Investigation, can produce root cause analyses. We evaluate our agent’s output against root causes identified by our engineers. In these evaluations, it has demonstrated stronger reasoning than Opus 5 and has successfully diagnosed the most complex production incidents we’ve tested.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"4069839032c1\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Sualeh Asif\",\"authorRole\":\"Director of ML\",\"company\":\"SpaceXAI\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"a7b600ddd0b2\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"47f28fbeb156\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“Claude Fable 5.1 is the most capable model we’ve run on CursorBench 3.2, scoring 73.4% at max effort. We found it especially skilled at verifying its own work, allowing it to take on difficult coding tasks from start to finish.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]},{\"_key\":\"fd8112e83057\",\"_type\":\"testimonial\",\"audioUrl\":null,\"authorName\":\"Yuhao Zhang\",\"authorRole\":\"Research Lead\",\"company\":\"Samaya\",\"quote\":[{\"_key\":\"c3c1e6ae661b\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"9e9a33b6362d\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"“We evaluate models and systems on real-world investor workflows. On FrontierFinance, our latest finance benchmark, Claude Fable 5.1 shows a clear gain over Fable 5, with a 55.9% rubric score compared to 49.2%. The gain comes from its ability to dig harder into grounded, authoritative sources: on one earnings question, it went straight to the call transcript and captured the exact figures management cited, where other models leaned on secondary coverage.”\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}]}],\"testimonialLabel\":\"Quote\"},{\"_key\":\"6bb402106119\",\"_type\":\"manateeNavMarker\",\"anchor\":{\"_type\":\"slug\",\"current\":\"scientific-research\"},\"heroLabel\":\"Scientific research\",\"markDefs\":null,\"navLabel\":\"Scientific research\"},{\"_key\":\"cc1ad6772e8d\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"9e41ef8cb62b\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Scientific research\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"h2\"},{\"_key\":\"c0befd610e54\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"4d14b0773f7f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"We tested the scientific research capabilities of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 across a wide range of domains. What we found—which includes the early examples we share below—adds to the evidence that AI models will soon make important contributions to scientific discovery.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"48047c4c5f69\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"ed8535452da3\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Molecular design\"},{\"_key\":\"2128da5d638f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\",\"em\"],\"text\":\".\"},{\"_key\":\"ef86123535f7\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\" \"},{\"_key\":\"d8752839504a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Many modern medicines work by binding to targets within the body to block, activate, or deliver something to them. High-affinity binders are necessary for drugs to work at lower doses; designing one is the first step in the development process for many common drug modalities. To see how well Claude Mythos 5.1 could do at this task, we gave the model access to open-source protein design and folding tools and sent its designs to two external organizations for experimental validation. Mythos 5.1 proved able to design very high-affinity binders. On three targets, \"},{\"_key\":\"368e5f5cd6f1\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"sup\"],\"text\":\"[3]\"},{\"_key\":\"560b44789a09\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" its binding affinities were 10 times higher than the best designs submitted to \"},{\"_key\":\"65a6c16021a9\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"29529e7a9561\"],\"text\":\"Adaptyv Bio’s protein design competitions\"},{\"_key\":\"7cff33ed6401\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". Its hit rate (that is, the number of designs that were viable binders) was the strongest we’ve measured to date: it reached nearly 50% across 12 targets. (Hit rates of 10–15% are typical in protein design today.)\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"29529e7a9561\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://proteinbase.com/competitions\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"683b117514ca\",\"_type\":\"manateeVideoSwitcher\",\"markDefs\":null,\"videos\":[{\"_key\":\"17be6cb219a8\",\"_type\":\"manateeVideo\",\"animatedPoster\":{\"_type\":\"file\",\"asset\":{\"_ref\":\"file-dd1483b60a862b1acb3ed4359631ec99653a84c7-webm\",\"_type\":\"reference\"}},\"animatedPosterUrl\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/files/4zrzovbb/website/dd1483b60a862b1acb3ed4359631ec99653a84c7.webm\",\"caption\":\"Claude-designed protein binders (orange) for each of 12 targets (grey). Every design in the video was confirmed to bind in the lab. Structures shown are ESMFold2 predictions.\",\"poster\":{\"_type\":\"image\",\"alt\":\"Claude-designed protein binders (orange) for each of 12 targets (grey). Every design in the video was confirmed to bind in the lab. Structures shown are ESMFold2 predictions.\",\"asset\":{\"_ref\":\"image-4b8acf7ac952566415849134b65025b89a197bf6-1920x1080-jpg\",\"_type\":\"reference\"},\"height\":1080,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4zrzovbb/website/4b8acf7ac952566415849134b65025b89a197bf6-1920x1080.jpg\",\"width\":1920},\"youtubeId\":\"Rfhb8EzILmM\"}]},{\"_key\":\"e98472710ffa\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"9a9ca7d4e692\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Computational analysis and modeling\"},{\"_key\":\"8fa4fbf25937\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". Claude Fable 5.1 trained a neural network to create a new, high-resolution elevation map of a third of the planet Venus. Its work was based on radar images taken by NASA’s Magellan mission more than 30 years ago and a \"},{\"_key\":\"35f76ef9f91c\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"5a4e2378278a\"],\"text\":\"map\"},{\"_key\":\"53acd88237b5\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" that already existed for one-fifth of the planet. Claude’s new map now reveals details down to two to three kilometers, rather than 10 to 20, and shows heights up to 25% more accurately than before.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"5a4e2378278a\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://agupubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1029/2012EO120002\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"27f574901eed\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"db149d0d0042\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"We’re \"},{\"_key\":\"7a2c20c28e24\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"887787906a43\"],\"text\":\"releasing this map\"},{\"_key\":\"33b28f50bf8d\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" under a Creative Commons license in advance of upcoming NASA VERITAS and ESA EnVision missions, in hopes that it might help them determine which geologic features to target for future observation.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"887787906a43\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://zenodo.org/records/22164484\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"fcdda7e27023\",\"_type\":\"mediaGallery\",\"items\":[{\"_key\":\"5d6b92eb5c0a\",\"_type\":\"mediaGalleryItem\",\"media\":{\"image\":{\"_type\":\"imageWithCaption\",\"asset\":{\"_ref\":\"image-4d8f06a743ecfc6ec87ccde0b1964e48175a141e-800x800-png\",\"_type\":\"reference\"},\"caption\":[{\"_key\":\"3129c270b35e\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"5340731ca7da\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Magellan Venus\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"}],\"columnWidth\":\"full-width\",\"file\":{\"_type\":\"file\",\"asset\":{\"_ref\":\"file-3a8b31b9b3525f607fc1da0c878b2ee1ea56e54c-mp4\",\"_type\":\"reference\"}},\"loop\":true,\"muted\":true,\"showControls\":true,\"thumbnail\":null,\"url\":\"https://cdn.sanity.io/files/4zrzovbb/website/3a8b31b9b3525f607fc1da0c878b2ee1ea56e54c.mp4\"}}}],\"markDefs\":null},{\"_key\":\"560dcfff7c01\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"a69f8eebc99a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Computational biology\"},{\"_key\":\"07fed3c5c809\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\",\"em\"],\"text\":\".\"},{\"_key\":\"0e3afd45e74b\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" In computational biology, it’s common to run task-specific machine learning models on GPUs. The speed of these models is therefore a bottleneck to research progress. Mythos 5.1 provided one solution to this problem: by writing custom GPU kernels and caching their intermediate results, it sped up seven open-source deep learning models by up to 2.5 times (with identical outputs).\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"a0243c6bab4b\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"9bde93237243\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"The benefits of such speed-ups accumulate quickly. In any given experiment, biologists might run these models thousands of times (for example, testing every possible mutation near every human gene). On analyses like these, the optimized models cut estimated GPU costs by 30–60%. This kind of optimization would normally take a team of performance engineers weeks, and is often unaffordable for academic labs. Mythos 5.1 was able to do it in just days, using the publicly available source code alone. We plan to open-source these optimizations soon.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"13630ae3c50f\",\"_type\":\"viewSwitcher\",\"markDefs\":null,\"views\":[{\"_key\":\"6656904cb517\",\"_type\":\"view\",\"body\":[{\"_key\":\"speedupchart\",\"_type\":\"chart\",\"animate\":false,\"chartType\":\"bar\",\"data\":\"group,groupNote,series,value,label\\n**ChromBPNet** (6M),2.1-kb DNA sequence,speedup,1.6,1.6×\\n**Flashzoi** (200M),524-kb DNA sequence,speedup,1.8,1.8×\\n**Enformer** (250M),196-kb DNA sequence,speedup,1.4,1.4×\\n**Profluent-E1** (600M),\\\"1,024-amino-acid protein\\\",speedup,1.6,1.6×\\n**ProGen2** (6.4B),512-amino-acid protein,speedup,2.5,2.5×\\n**Evo 2** (7B),8-kb DNA sequence,speedup,1.6,1.6×\\n**Evo 2** (40B),8-kb DNA sequence,speedup,1.4,1.4×\",\"footnote\":\"Inference speedup for seven open-source protein and genomics models on an NVIDIA H100\",\"markDefs\":null,\"orientation\":\"horizontal\",\"referenceLine\":{\"label\":\"Original implementation\",\"value\":1},\"series\":[{\"_key\":\"spd\",\"_type\":\"series\",\"color\":\"heather\",\"fill\":\"solid\",\"id\":\"speedup\",\"name\":\"Optimized\"}],\"title\":\"Inference speedup\",\"yAxis\":{\"label\":\"Speedup on an NVIDIA H100 (×)\",\"max\":3,\"min\":0,\"ticks\":\"0,1,2,3\"}}],\"label\":\"Inference speedup\"},{\"_key\":\"751e833fea53\",\"_type\":\"view\",\"body\":[{\"_key\":\"costchart\",\"_type\":\"chart\",\"animate\":false,\"chartType\":\"bar\",\"data\":\"group,groupNote,series,value,label\\n**Enformer** (250M),\\\"every mutation, 10-kb window around 20,000 genes\\\",original,30,$30k\\n**Enformer** (250M),,optimized,21,$21k\\n**Flashzoi** (200M),\\\"every mutation, 10-kb window around 20,000 genes\\\",original,14,$14k\\n**Flashzoi** (200M),,optimized,7,$7k\\n**Evo 2** (40B),3 million ClinVar variants,original,18,$18k\\n**Evo 2** (40B),,optimized,8,$8k\",\"footnote\":\"Estimated GPU cost of three genome-wide analyses before and after optimization, at cloud list price. Evo 2 40B saves more on a whole job (2.3x) than per forward (1.4x) because some of its optimizations only pay off across many sequences.\",\"markDefs\":null,\"orientation\":\"horizontal\",\"series\":[{\"_key\":\"orig\",\"_type\":\"series\",\"color\":\"coral\",\"fill\":\"solid\",\"id\":\"original\",\"name\":\"Original implementation\"},{\"_key\":\"opt\",\"_type\":\"series\",\"color\":\"heather\",\"fill\":\"solid\",\"id\":\"optimized\",\"name\":\"Optimized\"}],\"title\":\"Estimated cost savings on genome-wide analyses\",\"yAxis\":{\"label\":\"Estimated GPU cost (NVIDIA H100, cloud list price, USD thousands)\",\"max\":35,\"min\":0,\"ticks\":\"0,10,20,30\"}}],\"label\":\"Estimated cost savings on genome-wide analyses\"}]},{\"_key\":\"c4ace37f3f5c\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"464322347073\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"As our models’ scientific capabilities improve, our investment in scientific progress is also growing. Last week, we previewed the \"},{\"_key\":\"a4fcbc5ae63a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"94abef0740c7\"],\"text\":\"Model Hardware Standard\"},{\"_key\":\"cc3a9319ce4f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", which allows Claude to directly and safely operate laboratory equipment. We’ve also recently \"},{\"_key\":\"84ae07025b94\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"e9b6a2ed28bb\"],\"text\":\"expanded our support for scientists\"},{\"_key\":\"5f9c7fc1c5e3\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" through our \"},{\"_key\":\"6e18d279237b\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"0a2d6c91d16f\"],\"text\":\"AI for Science program\"},{\"_key\":\"fd37ea5629db\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", which provides free credits to researchers working on high-impact scientific projects, and we are offering steeply discounted usage through our new \"},{\"_key\":\"1d6776db26a8\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"72ad176f58db\"],\"text\":\"Claude Team plan for scientists\"},{\"_key\":\"8a27818f312c\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\".\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"94abef0740c7\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-hardware-standard-research-preview\"},{\"_key\":\"e9b6a2ed28bb\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/expanding-support-for-scientists\"},{\"_key\":\"0a2d6c91d16f\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/ai-for-science-program\"},{\"_key\":\"72ad176f58db\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://claude.com/programs/team-plan-for-scientists\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"8a9f66e04c89\",\"_type\":\"manateeNavMarker\",\"anchor\":{\"_type\":\"slug\",\"current\":\"safety-security-and-alignment\"},\"heroLabel\":\"Safety, security, and alignment\",\"markDefs\":null,\"navLabel\":\"Safety\"},{\"_key\":\"620a1f803644\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"4fabdb9172df\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Safety, security, and alignment\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"h2\"},{\"_key\":\"fa099c3d6dff\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"a90ce7f2c4a4\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"AI models’ agentic capabilities have become much more powerful over the past two years. But as we’ve \"},{\"_key\":\"81788a55af6c\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"d14b3bb61026\"],\"text\":\"documented\"},{\"_key\":\"4fd2eb7db6ba\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", greater autonomy comes with new risks. Work on safety, security, and alignment needs to advance at the same pace as AI capabilities. Yesterday, we \"},{\"_key\":\"311026c8b736\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"0000d3b4ad89\"],\"text\":\"published a report\"},{\"_key\":\"eceda85d7bf9\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" describing how we are improving our own alignment and security efforts\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"d14b3bb61026\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/investigating-incidents-cybersecurity-evals\"},{\"_key\":\"0000d3b4ad89\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-alignment-security-efforts\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"1cbbdf79808c\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"66f3ea192373\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Prior to releasing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, we (and, in some cases, external researchers) subjected the models to extensive testing for risks across many areas. We describe these efforts in full in our \"},{\"_key\":\"e2cc58dc4fef\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"35882d48ceb9\"],\"text\":\"System Card\"},{\"_key\":\"2fbbe1a8e187\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"; below is a brief summary.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"35882d48ceb9\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-5-1-mythos-5-1-system-card\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"006438491597\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"994e1f4371e2\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Chemical and biological risks\"},{\"_key\":\"bbc65644961f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". We tested the extent to which Claude Mythos 5.1 could help create chemical or biological weapons. This involved expert red-teaming, automated evaluations, and a tabletop exercise that paired PhD-level biologists with AI experts, testing whether the models could match human specialists’ performance. Mythos 5.1’s capabilities are greater than those of Mythos 5. However, our evaluations indicate that it still falls short of the next risk tier defined in our \"},{\"_key\":\"88a36687843e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"7bc8da56ffbb\"],\"text\":\"Responsible Scaling Policy\"},{\"_key\":\"ebe76934f0ba\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". We are therefore deploying Mythos 5.1 with the \"},{\"_key\":\"91b5365de993\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"1f54f7029291\"],\"text\":\"same safeguards\"},{\"_key\":\"b8f3b0df8297\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" that we applied to Mythos 5, which restrict access to research biology capabilities.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"7bc8da56ffbb\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/responsible-scaling-policy\"},{\"_key\":\"1f54f7029291\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-fable-5-s-biology-safeguards\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"e88e7829b3e5\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"124afcc8c72b\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Cyber risks\"},{\"_key\":\"2051e16adb2d\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". We ran a suite of evaluations to assess the cyber capabilities of Claude Mythos 5.1 (with cybersecurity safeguards off). Overall, the model demonstrates the strongest cyber capabilities of any model we’ve released, though it still falls within the lower category of risk in our \"},{\"_key\":\"fc019df9dd20\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"ec328def08bd\"],\"text\":\"Frontier Compliance Framework\"},{\"_key\":\"05152d4e7d7e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". We also performed extensive stress-testing of our cybersecurity safeguards for Fable 5.1: in addition to our own dynamic evaluation of their robustness, we commissioned external testing from two organizations, along with automated testing by \"},{\"_key\":\"7c7f1d28c71f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"e1f0f1df0b5b\"],\"text\":\"Gray Swan\"},{\"_key\":\"1dc6dc9193e4\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". As with Fable 5 and Opus 5, we have not found evidence of a \"},{\"_key\":\"10b0c77bc26c\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"5edad6667166\"],\"text\":\"critical-severity jailbreak\"},{\"_key\":\"25bf14c5ee21\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" for these safeguards.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"ec328def08bd\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/compliance-framework-SB53\"},{\"_key\":\"e1f0f1df0b5b\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.grayswan.ai/\"},{\"_key\":\"5edad6667166\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/fable-safeguards-jailbreak-framework\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"6c3be7828bc6\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"2027a2de9199\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Agentic safety\"},{\"_key\":\"d8e792c902f3\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\". We ran evaluations of how Claude Mythos 5.1 responds to malicious requests and prompt injections (adversarial instructions hidden within content processed by AI models). It refused malicious agentic coding and computer use requests at a comparable rate to Mythos 5, Sonnet 5, and Opus 5, and it is our most robust model to date on an external \"},{\"_key\":\"9d91bbe22010\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"955a5060abfb\"],\"text\":\"prompt injection benchmark\"},{\"_key\":\"6436172f6d49\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\".\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"955a5060abfb\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-5-1-mythos-5-1-system-card\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"9ec7556a78ff\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"b7a047385404\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Alignment\"},{\"_key\":\"6aefd2d911d9\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\",\"em\"],\"text\":\".\"},{\"_key\":\"f135ff2efe16\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" We tested the model’s behavior through static and interactive behavioral evaluations, analyses of its internal thinking using \"},{\"_key\":\"b73a98e2bc2e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"23648af98f70\"],\"text\":\"natural language autoencoders\"},{\"_key\":\"4134b0c0b6b7\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", misalignment-related capability evaluations, a review of our training data, and analyses of our internal pilot use. We also received reports from external testing.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"23648af98f70\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/research/natural-language-autoencoders\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"c178025fbd2c\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"31626937a8d0\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Our automated behavioral audit found that Claude Mythos 5.1 is better aligned across most metrics than its predecessor, Mythos 5. The model is significantly less likely than Mythos 5 to try to access resources outside of its test environment when assigned an otherwise impossible task. It is also less likely than Mythos 5 to use motivated reasoning to justify its actions (for instance, by reasoning that the situation is a simulation or evaluation), and it is less likely to ignore explicit constraints in pursuit of users’ goals. From our review of its training data, Mythos 5.1 both attempts reward hacking (or cheating), and succeeds at it, at a lower overall rate than Mythos 5.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"b29b6c9a23e6\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"17cb9437d2e0\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Though generally our alignment evaluations showed improvements, our testing found the model can still sometimes bypass approvals and auto-mode classifiers (as we discuss in more detail in our \"},{\"_key\":\"c700868b78a6\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"50c4dcefb25c\"],\"text\":\"System Card\"},{\"_key\":\"e3d9a3f718c5\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"). There are also limitations to the coverage provided by our alignment assessment. Currently, our automated behavioral audit provides less visibility into very long-context work and multi-agent settings. We also have less coverage of impossible tasks (which can elicit more abnormal and misaligned behavior) than we’d like, although we’ve recently made improvements in this domain and are working hard to continue doing so.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"50c4dcefb25c\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-5-1-mythos-5-1-system-card\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"1b1a5a0b746f\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"d3110504e422\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"We have also improved our safeguards so that they allow our models to be more useful without compromising on safety. We describe these changes below.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"146449b4ac71\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"83e6d270b63a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Automated safeguards for enterprises\"},{\"_key\":\"61ad5ff1a99a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\",\"em\"],\"text\":\".\"},{\"_key\":\"07173e1060d4\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" \"},{\"_key\":\"8bbe3743727f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"bcbb7f5cc2a0\"],\"text\":\"Enterprise Frontier Safeguards\"},{\"_key\":\"bd3cf7454f0d\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" (EFS) allows us to detect and respond to misuse of our models while still providing our enterprise customers the privacy of a zero data retention agreement. With EFS, customers store their data on their own cloud infrastructure, rather than on Anthropic’s systems; any human review is, by default, done by the customer themselves, rather than Anthropic. We developed EFS in close collaboration with more than 100 customers across industries like financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, telecom, law, retail, and the public sector, and with our cloud partners at Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"bcbb7f5cc2a0\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/enterprise-frontier-safeguards\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"da83739b277d\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"49aac5159d3c\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"EFS will be supported on Claude Code, Claude Enterprise, the Claude Platform, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. It’s rolling out in phases, starting this fall. As noted above, customers who are eligible for EFS can use Fable 5.1 (and Fable 5) with zero data retention until EFS is ready. You can read more about EFS \"},{\"_key\":\"774d49d6eb9c\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"aeb27a122715\"],\"text\":\"here\"},{\"_key\":\"838db74fcf42\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"; to request access, please complete \"},{\"_key\":\"4ba2c7345883\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"fc35bdf6f45b\"],\"text\":\"this form\"},{\"_key\":\"8d938a27a0e5\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\".\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"fc35bdf6f45b\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"href\":\"https://claude.com/form/enterprise-frontier-safeguards\"},{\"_key\":\"aeb27a122715\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/enterprise-frontier-safeguards\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"85eed2b97f06\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"8997eec9fd6f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"More precise safeguards for biology and cybersecurity\"},{\"_key\":\"247805bce282\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\",\"em\"],\"text\":\". \"},{\"_key\":\"113bb2748d87\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"In the past few months, we’ve made progress in making our safeguards for Fable 5.1 more precise: ensuring that they’re less likely to flag benign content (like queries about medical issues or cyberdefenders using the model to make their systems safer), but still ensuring they provide robust protection against genuine threats.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"cb405c13e34f\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"85f6da219f46\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"As we \"},{\"_key\":\"c0b497f52d0a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"1bd52966ab7d\"],\"text\":\"recently shared\"},{\"_key\":\"0a35c92bc73e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", our latest biology safeguards for Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 fire 85% less often for benign requests related to elementary biology and medical questions (relative to those that launched with Fable 5). However, queries related to research and development in the life sciences will still be directed to our Opus models. We’re making the model’s life sciences capabilities available to professionals through an access program for Claude Mythos 5.1 that we’ve developed in partnership with the US government, which we discuss below.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"1bd52966ab7d\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-fable-5-s-biology-safeguards\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"2bce345c3d7e\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"fd5e8050e43a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"With Fable 5.1, we’re updating our cybersecurity safeguards to be more precise. We’re also now allowing Fable 5.1 to be used for identifying software vulnerabilities—that is, to conduct the kind of defensive work that improves software security. As a result of these changes, Claude Code users can expect an average of around 60% fewer interventions per session from our cyber safeguards, relative to the previous safeguards on Fable 5. Our safeguards do, however, still redirect several kinds of dual-use cybersecurity tasks (tasks that might have helpful \"},{\"_key\":\"139decdc9121\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"em\"],\"text\":\"or\"},{\"_key\":\"44793b608ff5\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" harmful applications) to our Opus models. This includes penetration testing, exploit generation, and binary-based vulnerability scanning.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"4d4f37f0e2f8\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"980cc10e75b6\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Anti-distillation mechanisms\"},{\"_key\":\"e5e3a9541803\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\",\"em\"],\"text\":\".\"},{\"_key\":\"73ecac6ac823\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" Distillation is a method used to extract the capabilities of advanced models. It is often employed on an industrial scale, using thousands of fake accounts. Distillation is a safety risk, since the distilled capabilities can subsequently be released without adequate safeguards. Fable 5.1 comes with strengthened mechanisms to make distillation attacks harder. For example, it is no longer possible for new API accounts (those created from today onwards) to manually edit Claude’s prior context in a multi-turn conversation while preserving the transcript of Claude’s prior thinking. This closes off a common, publicly documented distillation technique, which allowed distillers to illicitly extract Claude’s thinking. We’re rolling out the change gradually, to minimize disruption: existing accounts are not currently affected by this change, though it will apply to all users with future model releases. A small number of customers’ custom integrations will then be affected. Our \"},{\"_key\":\"42c922916aab\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"e0f0a67581ac\"],\"text\":\"Help Center article\"},{\"_key\":\"aff969eaa8a9\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" explains more about this change and the adjustments that developers can make.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"e0f0a67581ac\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16761192\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"e31e6a5834ff\",\"_type\":\"manateeNavMarker\",\"anchor\":{\"_type\":\"slug\",\"current\":\"mythos\"},\"heroLabel\":\"Claude Mythos 5.1\",\"markDefs\":null,\"navLabel\":\"Claude Mythos 5.1\"},{\"_key\":\"771d5b372731\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"4c75f6a26ad3\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Trusted access for Claude Mythos 5.1\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"h2\"},{\"_key\":\"1cd86f37a7a5\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"09a81adf3a5e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Claude Mythos 5.1 is identical to Fable 5.1, but it offers more permissive safeguards for vetted individuals and organizations whose work is affected by the cybersecurity and life sciences restrictions outlined above. It will be available through two trusted access programs:\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"56743b1a0801\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"845ed512c040\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Cyber Verification Program:\"},{\"_key\":\"49ddf118103f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" The CVP currently provides access to certain Opus- and Sonnet-class models with reduced cyber safeguards for defensive security work. In the near future, this program will also include access to Claude Mythos-class models. \"},{\"_key\":\"7d33a4e4a6d0\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"703138737e77\"],\"text\":\"Apply to join the CVP here\"},{\"_key\":\"c0837c979fc7\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\".\"}],\"level\":1,\"listItem\":\"bullet\",\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"703138737e77\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://portal.anthropic.com/programs/cvp\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"d943c7995958\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"e531e25dccdf\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"strong\"],\"text\":\"Life Sciences Verification Program:\"},{\"_key\":\"8d311d6893f7\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" The LSVP is designed so that life sciences professionals can use Claude Mythos 5.1 with safeguards designed for professional research and development activities (while all other safeguards remain in place). In partnership with the US government, we have enrolled our first participants, and we plan to expand access to this program to the broader life sciences community.\"}],\"level\":1,\"listItem\":\"bullet\",\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"e0c69e6a7307\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"375ec457a4a5\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"In addition to these trusted access programs, \"},{\"_key\":\"2d7e45ee9850\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"10b4d72f716e\"],\"text\":\"Claude Security\"},{\"_key\":\"6b52731a1768\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", our product that scans codebases for vulnerabilities and suggests patches for human review, is now also powered by Claude Mythos 5.1.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"10b4d72f716e\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://claude.com/product/claude-security\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"0c93e1afcbf9\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"4d46c08ee34f\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Compliance with the EU AI Act\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"h2\"},{\"_key\":\"ac1a0e6da03a\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"3b29a35ab6ab\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"In July 2026, Anthropic (along with \"},{\"_key\":\"0090f91ad75e\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"675a489eb720\"],\"text\":\"190 other signatories\"},{\"_key\":\"b204b1263aea\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", including several other major AI model providers) signed the EU AI Act’s Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"675a489eb720\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/strong-backing-code-practice-transparency-ai-generated-content\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"67f81c6c073a\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"ec1196b54276\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"This required us to add a watermark—a numerical way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing a piece of text—to the outputs of models released after August 2, 2026. As we \"},{\"_key\":\"29b4afcc9d21\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"1cd774849139\"],\"text\":\"recently explained\"},{\"_key\":\"3b7fa4f0a4d5\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\", this watermark is invisible to anyone who does not have the detection API. It has no practical impact on the quality or content of Claude’s outputs and contains no information about the user, their organization, or their conversations with Claude.\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"1cd774849139\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-text-watermark\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"5a88af64a7db\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"64716ad0184a\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"The Act also required us to provide a way for users to tell whether a text likely contains the watermark. We are thus rolling out a detection API in private preview. It is currently available to eligible organizations (such as regulators, law enforcement, media, fact-checkers, independent researchers, educational organizations, and EU civil society groups) as required under EU law. It is also available for enterprises that are similarly obligated to verify watermarking for their own compliance with the Act. We plan to expand access to the detection API over time. You can register interest in access \"},{\"_key\":\"e10924b3c2aa\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"51b0734d90c6\"],\"text\":\"here\"},{\"_key\":\"bf25bf4e2386\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\".\"}],\"markDefs\":[{\"_key\":\"51b0734d90c6\",\"_type\":\"link\",\"blank\":true,\"href\":\"https://forms.gle/9tGA33hPJJwtHsMk9\"}],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"74bf3d32ee33\",\"_type\":\"manateeNavMarker\",\"anchor\":{\"_type\":\"slug\",\"current\":\"cost-and-availability\"},\"markDefs\":null,\"navLabel\":\"Cost and availability\"},{\"_key\":\"811591ef110f\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"51f13fefb586\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Cost and availability\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"h2\"},{\"_key\":\"d4f08d2503d0\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"c03035da2586\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"Claude Fable 5.1 is available today on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Developers can get started with \"},{\"_key\":\"aa3faa8848bf\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[\"code\"],\"text\":\"claude-fable-5-1\"},{\"_key\":\"cde746ee8b44\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\" on the Claude API.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"87610af94038\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"d7ff61667039\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"As mentioned above, we have reduced the price of Fable 5.1’s cache reads (where the model reuses context it has already processed) wherever usage is billed by token, such as on our API. Cache reads now cost 75% less, or $0.25 per million tokens.\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"464d0da599e8\",\"_type\":\"block\",\"children\":[{\"_key\":\"23dec96faeee\",\"_type\":\"span\",\"marks\":[],\"text\":\"This change leads to a substantial reduction in the overall cost of running the model. For typical workloads, costs are reduced by around 25% relative to Fable 5. For complex coding and highly agentic tasks, the savings could be up to around 45%. The graph below illustrates why this change makes such a big difference:\"}],\"markDefs\":[],\"style\":\"normal\"},{\"_key\":\"workloadchart\",\"_type\":\"chart\",\"animate\":false,\"chartType\":\"bar\",\"data\":\"panel,panelTitle,group,series,value,stack,ground,label\\ntypical,Typical workload,**Fable 5**,reads,40,yes,cloud,100\\ntypical,,**Fable 5**,other,60,yes,,\\ntypical,,**Fable 5.1**,reads,11,yes,matcha,75 (~25% less)\\ntypical,,**Fable 5.1**,other,64,yes,,\\nagentic,Highly agentic workload,**Fable 5**,reads,65,yes,cloud,100\\nagentic,,**Fable 5**,other,35,yes,,\\nagentic,,**Fable 5.1**,reads,17,yes,matcha,55 (~45% less)\\nagentic,,**Fable 5.1**,other,38,yes,,\",\"footnote\":\"Indexed cost of running the same workloads on Fable 5 and Fable 5.1, at usage-based pricing measured at default effort over four weeks of actual usage in August 2026. id="main-content" class=""><article><div class="page-wrapper PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__hero"><div class="PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__header"><div class="PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__subjects body-3 bold"><span>Announcements</span></div><h1 class="headline-1 PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__title">Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers</h1><div class="body-3 agate">Sep 1, 2026</div><div data-theme="ivory"></div></div><div class="PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__illustrationHeroWrapper"><div class="Illustration-module-scss-module__WyGOtq__root Illustration-module-scss-module__WyGOtq__aspect-wide Illustration-module-scss-module__WyGOtq__padding-lg Illustration-module-scss-module__WyGOtq__radius-lg bg-sky"><div class="Illustration-module-scss-module__WyGOtq__inner"><img alt="Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers" loading="lazy" width="1000" height="1000" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="" style="color:transparent" src="https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/images/4zrzovbb/website/60d57c0d0bf031e140de678692f7c3ef2d885ce3-1000x1000.svg"/></div></div></div></div><div class="page-wrapper"><article><div class=""><div class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__body" data-theme="ivory"><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Today we’re announcing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a solution that combines the privacy of zero data retention (ZDR) with state-of-the-art safeguards for detecting misuse. EFS works by storing data in cloud infrastructure controlled by the customer, not Anthropic. EFS will be rolling out to customers in phases, starting later this fall. To make the transition smooth, eligible customers will receive ZDR on Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 until EFS is ready.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">We developed EFS in close collaboration with more than 100 customers in industries like financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, telecom, law, retail, and the public sector, and with our cloud partners at Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">EFS will be supported on Claude Code, Claude Enterprise, the Claude Platform, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google’s Agent Platform, and Microsoft Foundry.</p><div class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__media-column"><div class="Video-module-scss-module__qJNyFq__post-wrapper"><figure class="Video-module-scss-module__qJNyFq__post-video-container"><!--$!--><template data-dgst="BAILOUT_TO_CLIENT_SIDE_RENDERING"></template><!--/$--></figure></div></div><h2 class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column headline-5 post-section" id="solving-the-dilemma-of-frontier-security">Solving the dilemma of frontier security</h2><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Mythos-class models, like <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1">Claude Fable 5.1</a>, represent a major increase in intelligence and agentic capabilities. However, with that increase comes the potential for both misuse and autonomous misbehavior.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Over the last few months, we’ve seen substantial evidence of attempted misuse of AI models. These range from typical forms of abuse, such as fraud, to sophisticated cyberattacks, which can include agents autonomously engaging in destructive behavior. Some of these instances involve theft or misappropriation of enterprise customers’ credentials, which are difficult to detect without the ability to monitor traffic and detect abnormal behavior.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Furthermore, because the <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/news/disrupting-AI-espionage">most sophisticated misuse</a> can involve many tasks spread across multiple sessions and accounts, it is not sufficient to run automated analysis on each interaction separately and then instantaneously discard the data. Effective detection requires storing data for a meaningful period of time so that it can be correlated across time and accounts.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">For this reason, we introduced 30-day data retention starting with Fable 5. This policy was not motivated by a desire to train on enterprise data: Anthropic has never trained on enterprise data without explicit permission, and never will.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">The enterprises we worked with generally understood the safety and security value of data retention, but many–especially in regulated industries–found it difficult to use models with data retention. We therefore sat down with customers to design a solution that could provide the best of both worlds: the privacy of ZDR and the safety allowed by monitoring across time and accounts.</p><h2 class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column headline-5 post-section" id="designed-with-our-customers">Designed with our customers</h2><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">We built Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with feedback from the experts who will use it every day: security, product, compliance, and delivery teams. One of the groups we worked with was the Analysis and Resilience Center for Systemic Risk (ARC), whose members include the chief information security officers of the largest US banks, including Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Citi, Bank of America, and Wells Fargo. </p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">We also worked with leaders at companies such as Comcast, KPMG, Mastercard, Salesforce, and Visa, to make sure the design held up across industries. Our conversations spanned a quarter of the Fortune 100, every US global systemically important bank, and virtually every regulated industry.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Here is what we heard from this wide range of customers, and what we built into EFS to address these common concerns:</p><h3 class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column headline-6 post-subsection" id="on-monitoring">On monitoring</h3><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Enterprises have long applied monitoring for insider risk, and now want help upleveling monitoring for agents. Their concerns were about Anthropic’s automated monitoring systems meeting their regulatory standards.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text"><strong>With EFS, customers control how data gets reviewed. </strong>When monitoring detects a pattern that needs attention, those signals are sent directly to customers so they can review what the automated systems detected.</p><h3 class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column headline-6 post-subsection" id="on-data-storage">On data storage</h3><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">It’s a lot of work for enterprises to add another “trusted data vendor” for a number of reasons. They need to notify all of their customers who these vendors are and update contracts. They also have internal requirements for safely storing and auditing data, given its high level of sensitivity. Because of these concerns, we architected EFS so that customers have the ability to store data on their existing cloud infrastructure.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text"><strong>In EFS, customers can control their data storage and management.</strong> Customers want the ability to have their data live in infrastructure they control, under their own encryption keys, access policies, and audit logging. Activity data used for monitoring can be stored in the customer’s own cloud account (such as Amazon S3, Azure Blob Storage, or Google Cloud Storage).</p><h3 class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column headline-6 post-subsection" id="on-automated-and-human-review">On automated and human review</h3><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Even as automated review is becoming more effective, a person looking at a flag still adds value by confirming real misuse and clearing false positives. But what we heard from many customers, especially those in regulated industries, is that the person doing that review needs to be one of their own. Many operate under rules that tightly govern who may see certain information—privileged legal material, non-public information, drug-safety reports. Their teams are already trained and cleared for that work.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text"><strong>EFS has automated safety monitoring, no Anthropic human review required.</strong> Customers want protection against cyberattacks, and appreciate that these can be difficult to detect if they unfold across many sessions and accounts. With EFS, automated systems analyze a rolling window of traffic for signals of serious misuse, including attempts to develop offensive cyber or biological capabilities and signs of stolen or leaked credentials. Those flags go directly to the customer and their people take it from there – no human review by Anthropic employees is required.</p><div class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__media-column"><div class="Carousel-module-scss-module__hqckjG__carousel-wrapper"><div class="Carousel-module-scss-module__hqckjG__carousel-container"><div class="Carousel-module-scss-module__hqckjG__carousel-track"><div class="Carousel-module-scss-module__hqckjG__carousel-item QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__with-logo bg-ivory-medium"><div class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__quote-text body-2 serif">Enterprise Frontier Safeguards gives us exactly what we asked for: our logs stay in a Wells-managed environment under Wells-managed keys. We keep custody of our data while Anthropic operates the detection. That split is what lets our teams put frontier models to work safely and meet our obligations to customers, employees, and regulators. We helped shape these safeguards because our industry needs them.</div><footer class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__quote-footer"><cite class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__quote-text body-2 serif">Eight of our members worked with Anthropic to define what it would take to run the most capable frontier models inside a systemically important bank: who holds the data, who holds the keys, what automated review can and cannot see, and under what conditions a human is ever permitted to look. This collaboration is leading to the development and delivery of improved safeguards and standards that could scale across our industry and beyond.</div><footer class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__quote-text body-2 serif">One of the key tenets of the safeguards architecture is the ability for us to retain data and have it held outside the model itself, protected within our environment. There are areas of the firm, and of our clients&#x27; work, that are regulated and highly sensitive. class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__quote-text body-2 serif">Keeping customer data confidential is a promise Snowflake makes to every customer. We&#x27;ve always moved fast getting frontier models into their hands. The hard part was doing that safely under the strictest data guarantees. We partnered with Anthropic to design Enterprise Frontier Safeguards so we can do both: data stays in the customer&#x27;s environment, under keys they control, running Anthropic&#x27;s most capable models from day one. This is what responsible frontier AI looks like when it&#x27;s built with platforms in mind.</div><footer class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__quote-footer"><cite data.</div><footer class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__quote-footer"><cite class="QuoteCarousel-module-scss-module__XVJWRG__speaker-info body-3"><span class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column headline-5 post-section" id="how-efs-works">How EFS works</h2><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">These controls are designed to work the same way whether you access Claude directly from Anthropic or through a cloud partner. Customers on Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure will get equivalent controls, with their activity data stored in their own cloud account, in the environment they already trust. We’re also working to support third-party offerings that serve customers that are eligible for Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Customer-owned storage, Customer-Managed Encryption Keys, and fully automated review are each opt-in, so you enable the ones your organization needs. None of them change model behavior, API pricing, or rate limits.</p><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Anthropic doesn’t charge for Enterprise Frontier Safeguards. If customers elect to store their data in their cloud account, their cloud provider bills them for that storage, as well as reads, writes, and data egress fees, the same way it bills any other resource.</p><div class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__media-column"><figure class="ImageWithCaption-module-scss-module__Duq99q__e-imageWithCaption"><img alt="" loading="lazy" width="3840" height="4644" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" style="color:transparent" srcSet="/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F021fdfc765d03eaac26f5d2aa9cb06111b7a9297-3840x4644.png&amp;w=3840&amp;q=75 1x" src="/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F021fdfc765d03eaac26f5d2aa9cb06111b7a9297-3840x4644.png&amp;w=3840&amp;q=75"/></figure></div><h2 class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column headline-5 post-section" id="getting-started">Getting started</h2><p class="Body-module-scss-module__z40yvW__reading-column body-2 serif post-text">Enterprise Frontier Safeguards will roll out to customers in phases, with the goal of making it broadly available later this fall. To request access to Enterprise Frontier Safeguards, please complete this <a href="https://claude.com/form/enterprise-frontier-safeguards">form</a>.</p></div></div></article></div><div class="LinkGrid-module-scss-module__wTN57W__item"><h3 class="headline-6">Improving our alignment and security efforts</h3><p class="body-3 serif">On July 30, we reported three incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real computer systems. We are conducting an in-depth analysis of both incidents, and planning to work with METR for an independent review. In the meantime, we’re sharing some of the changes we’ve made over the past month.</p><a href="/news/improving-alignment-security-efforts" class="ButtonTextLink-module-scss-module__q8IAwW__textLink LinkGrid-module-scss-module__wTN57W__cta" referrerPolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"><span class="body-3">Read more</span><span class="ButtonTextLink-module-scss-module__q8IAwW__icon"><svg class="Icon-module-scss-module__lqbdHG__icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 21 21"><path d="M4.14585 9.87492L14.4584 9.87492L9.60419 5.04158L10.5 4.14575L16.8542 10.4999L10.5 16.8541L9.60419 15.9583L14.4584 11.1249L4.14585 11.1249L4.14585 9.87492Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span></a></div><div class="LinkGrid-module-scss-module__wTN57W__item"><h3 class="headline-6">Previewing the Model Hardware Standard</h3><p class="body-3 serif">We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers. </p><a href="/news/model-hardware-standard-research-preview" class="ButtonTextLink-module-scss-module__q8IAwW__textLink LinkGrid-module-scss-module__wTN57W__cta" referrerPolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"><span class="body-3">Read more</span><span class="ButtonTextLink-module-scss-module__q8IAwW__icon"><svg class="Icon-module-scss-module__lqbdHG__icon" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 21 21"><path d="M4.14585 9.87492L14.4584 9.87492L9.60419 5.04158L10.5 4.14575L16.8542 10.4999L10.5 16.8541L9.60419 15.9583L14.4584 11.1249L4.14585 11.1249L4.14585 9.87492Z" fill="currentColor"></path></svg></span></a></div><div class="LinkGrid-module-scss-module__wTN57W__item"><h3 class="headline-6"> Expanding our support for scientists</h3><p class="body-3 serif">Starting today, 10,000 scientists around the world can get Claude at no cost to start. Verified principal investigators qualify for a Claude Team subscription plan and then add their research team to Standard seats for free, or Premium seats for $15 per month, for up to a year.</p><a PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__hero\",\"children\":[[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"className\":\"PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__header\",\"children\":[[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"className\":\"PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__subjects body-3 bold\",\"children\":[[\"$\",\"span\",\"0\",{\"children\":\"Announcements\"}]]}],[\"$\",\"h1\",null,{\"className\":\"headline-1 PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__title\",\"children\":\"Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers\"}],[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"className\":\"body-3 agate\",\"children\":\"Sep 1, 2026\"}],[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"data-theme\":\"ivory\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"$L1c\",null,{\"ctaPosition\":\"hero\",\"link\":{\"_type\":\"link\",\"fileAsset\":null,\"modalId\":null,\"openInNewTab\":false,\"page\":null}}]}]]}],[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"className\":\"PostDetail-module-scss-module__UQuRMa__illustrationHeroWrapper\",\"children\":[\"$\",\"div\",null,{\"className\":\"Illustration-module-scss-module__WyGOtq__root
